# Hastings — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was Hastings?", "England, 1066, Norman conquest of England"),
    ("What is Hastings known for?", "William the Conqueror vs Harold II"),
    ("What is when/where?", "England, 1066, Norman conquest of England"),
    ("What is what happened?", "William the Conqueror vs Harold II"),
    ("What is significance?", "Harold died; England changed forever"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
